claude_proposed_widenings.name: RollKind.damage_roll
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing passive magic-item shape can express the rarity-scaled attack-roll bonus, but not the parallel bonus to damage rolls. Extending the existing roll-modifier surface is sufficient; no new top-level family is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: hit-triggered magic-item self-expiry / becomes_nonmagical_on_hit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item remains a piece of ammunition but stops being magical after it hits. Current item destruction policies model depletion or destruction, not a passive item losing its magical state on a hit-triggered event.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
